rationale: Operator, 2026-11-06, decision rubric. Nothing on main reads AISDLC_SIGNING_KEY_CONTENT since AISDLC-1173 (fed148f2). It is absent from the repository secret list, so it is likely an org secret the planner token cannot see. Operator checks org secrets, deletes it if present, and confirms AISDLC_SIGNING_KEY exists (also absent from the repo list), so release.yml is not silently skipping MCP tarball signing. Retiring its public key was rejected until someone confirms whether it is the same key material as the release key.
